_about: Minimal-pair sincere controls for the 25 Hu et al. Irony items. Only the facts in the context change, so the speaker's words are literally true and the correct answer is the item's original IncorrectLiteral option. Written by Claude, 2026-10-24. Not validated by human raters yet; validate before publishing.
1: In a shop, Lara tries on a dress. The dress fits her perfectly, exactly the right length. Lara asks Simon: "Does this dress fit me?" Simon answers: "Wow! That must be custom made! It's clearly the perfect size and length for you." What did Simon want to convey?
2: Christian is Shane's big brother. One day, Christian is helping Shane with his homework. Christian explains the homework to Shane. When Shane starts the assignment, he follows every one of Christian's instructions exactly. Christian says, "You are such a wonderful listener." What did Christian want to convey?
3: Andrew and Phil are good friends, but they play on different basketball teams. During one game, Phil scores basket after basket, even past Andrew's best defence. Andrew says, "You are so good at this." What did Andrew want to convey?
4: Patrick and Jon like to eat at restaurants. One afternoon, they are at a restaurant eating lunch. Patrick orders a bowl of noodles and Jon orders a rice dish. A waiter trips beside them, and Patrick calmly catches the falling tray without spilling a drop. Jon says, "You are so graceful." What did Jon want to convey?
5: Today Sarah and Tom are going to the beach to go swimming and sunbathing. It was Tom's idea, as he said it was going to be a lovely sunny day to go to the beach. When they arrive at the beach, the sky is clear, the sun is warm and the sea is calm. Sarah smiles. She says "Oh yes, a lovely day for going to the beach." What did Sarah want to convey?
6: It is a holiday. Stefan and Kim are sitting in the backseat of the car. They are singing along to their father's favourite songs and laughing together. Their father says: "Oh, it is so pleasant here." What did the father want to convey?
7: Kim and Jane are leaving the football stadium. Their team won in the final minute after an exciting match. Jane says, "What a wonderful game." Kim looks delighted. Kim replies: "I'm so glad I brought you." What did Jane want to convey?
8: Mark entered a golf tournament where he played brilliantly and won by six shots. His friend Hal watched the tournament and afterwards he said to Mark, "You sure are a good golfer." What did Hal want to convey?
9: Adrian's mother asks if he can look in his brother Tom's room to check if he has tidied up. Adrian opens the door to Tom's room, peers in, and sees that, as usual, everything is neatly put away and the floor is spotless. He shouts to his mother: "Mother, Tom, as usual, has done a splendid job tidying up!" What did Adrian want to convey?
10: Callie promised to bring a salad to Jason's dinner party. Callie had been working long shifts all week and had warned Jason she might not make it, but she arrived on time, salad in hand. Jason said, "I'm so glad that you were able to fit us into your busy schedule." What did Jason want to convey?
11: John is a teacher at an elementary school. When talking with the principal about a new student, who got the highest score of the year on her entrance examination, John said, "This one is really sharp." What did John want to convey?
12: Melissa's friend convinces her to accompany her to a nightclub that her friend says is "super hot". When they arrive, the heating is turned up so high that everyone is sweating and fanning themselves. Melissa turns to her friend and says, "The heat is really on in here." What did Melissa want to convey?
13: Your friend is working on his novel and has written three chapters this week that he is very proud of. When you ask him how it is going he says, "It couldn't be any better." What does your friend want to convey?
14: Tom, who is a gourmet chef, was offered a job at a new restaurant. Tom's potential employer offered him twice his current pay, extra holiday and full benefits. When you ask Tom what he thinks of the offer he says, "Well, their generosity knows no bounds." What does Tom want to convey?
15: Megan and Kristine were looking after the neighbor's children one afternoon. The kids were rude, screamed all afternoon and broke a lamp. On the way home, Kristine said, "Those kids were not fun at all." What does Kristine want to convey?
16: Laura and Lynn were having coffee at a local café. They were talking about a date that Laura had had the night before. They had gone hot-air ballooning at sunset and then to a surprise concert. Lynn said, "That sounds so exciting." What did Lynn want to convey?
17: While Tom and a new acquaintance from work, Sara, were chatting at a party, they noticed a colleague across the room. She was in the middle of a big group, telling a story that had everyone laughing. Tom points at the girl and comments: "The life of the party, right there." What did Tom want to convey?
18: Jane and her best friend, Arthur, were selling chocolates door to door to raise money for a charity event. Jane and Arthur approached a house where a kind couple bought three boxes and offered them lemonade. As they walked away, Jane comments: "People in this community are so nice!" What did Jane want to convey?
19: Penny, Juanita, and Jill have tickets to a basketball game. At halftime, Juanita offers to go get some drinks. Two minutes later, she is already back with all the drinks, and Jill remarks, "That was quick." What did Jill want to convey?
20: Mark gave his former colleague Krista tickets to a lecture where he was a guest speaker. The audience sat completely still for the whole hour and gave him a standing ovation. The next day Krista talked to Mary about the lecture. Krista said: "Oh, Mark held the audience's attention so well." What did Krista want to convey?
21: Tracy was in a dance recital and invited her roommate Steve to watch. Tracy moved beautifully and the audience cheered after every routine. The next day Steve was talking to Dawn about the recital. Steve said: "Some people have such natural grace!" What did Steve want to convey?
22: John finished the race far behind all the other competitors, having walked most of it. His friend shook his head and said to him, "You are so slow!" What did his friend want to convey?
23: The Jones' had hired a new gardener. After a week the lawn was neatly mown and the flower beds looked better than ever. John remarked to his wife, "He does such a good job!" What did John want to convey?
24: It was the night before her exam and Tilly had read all of the course texts twice and finished every practice paper. Her brother said, "I see your revision is going well." What did he want to convey?
25: Barb and Tony went to a high school reunion. Barb arrived early in an elegant dress that suited the occasion perfectly. Tony commented, "Classy outfit." What did Tony want to convey?
